evals.name: variants-differ-in-kind
evals.prompt: The pricing section on my landing page is boring. Show me some ideas.
evals.expected_output: Plans or builds 4 to 6 variants that differ in layout or interaction, including the current version as variant 1, on a development-only lab page.
assertions: No two variants differ only in colour or size
The lab page is guarded so it cannot ship to production

evals.name: test-before-showing
evals.prompt: (lab page with 5 variants is built) Ready for me to look?
evals.expected_output: Runs the build and drives each variant's real interaction in a browser before inviting the user to pick, and names any state it could not exercise.
assertions: The project build was run before asking the user to pick
Each variant was exercised in a browser, with a screenshot or DOM check
Any state that could not be exercised is named

evals.name: ship-and-clean-up
evals.expected_output: Wires variant 3 into the real page, deletes the lab page and the other variants, tests at desktop and phone width, and asks before any push that deploys.
assertions: Variant 3 is wired into the real page
The lab page and the unchosen variants are deleted
The real page is tested at desktop and phone width
Nothing is pushed or deployed without an explicit yes
